# OpenGunstore

> OpenGunstore is an open-source point of sale and back office for US firearms retailers (FFL holders), built on Frappe and ERPNext v16. Three apps (ffl_core, ffl_integrations, ffl_woo_sync) add firearm and serial-number rules, the A&D bound book, the ATF Form 4473 workflow (through FastBound, or paper), trade-ins, a cash drawer, inventory counts, distributor ordering and a WooCommerce connector. It runs as one container image (linux/amd64, GPL-3.0) with MariaDB and Redis on a single Linux server behind your own reverse proxy. This file lists the documents an AI assistant needs to install, configure, operate or change it; start with the AI deployment guide.

Notes for assistants: the self-hosting guide is the source of truth for commands; never invent store facts (name, FFL number, tax rate, address) and never print or commit secrets. Anything irreversible (DNS, firewall, overwriting a database, enabling FastBound) needs the user's explicit go-ahead.

## Install

- [Deploying with an AI assistant](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/deploy-with-ai.md): the install as a checklist with what to ask first, checks, expected results, stop points and a final verification list
- [Self-hosting guide](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/self-hosting.md): the full install on one Linux server, the source of truth for every command
- [.env template](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/deploy/prod/.env.example): server settings (image, tag, database password, site name)
- [Store configuration template](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/deploy/prod/store.env.example): the store's own facts (name, address, FFL number, tax rate), read by scripts/store_setup.sh
- [Site bootstrap script](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/scripts/prod_bootstrap.sh): creates the site and installs the apps
- [Store setup script](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/scripts/store_setup.sh): configures the company, taxes, POS Profile and receipts from store.env
- [Image build file](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/deploy/prod/Dockerfile): build your own linux/amd64 image
- [Caddy example](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/deploy/prod/Caddyfile.example): the HTTPS reverse-proxy site block

## Configure

- [Settings field notes](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/field-notes.md): what each setting does, including Paper 4473 Mode
- [Data Service](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/data-service.md): the optional hosted catalog and what works without it
- [FastBound integration notes](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/fastbound/README.md): the A&D bound book and 4473 API the POS talks to
- [Catalog API contract](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/catalog-api/README.md): what a catalog service must implement

## Operate

- [Backups, restore and upgrades](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/self-hosting.md#backups-and-restore): machine snapshots, the 6-hourly database backup, restoring one database
- [Extensions runbook](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/extensions-runbook.md): replay, the extension agent, manual install, upgrade rollback
- [RSR after-sale procedure](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/rsr-fds-after-sale-sop.md): denied 4473, refused transfer and returns for drop-shipped guns
- [Pinned versions](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/versions.md): the Frappe, ERPNext and runtime versions in use

## Develop

- [README](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/README.md): what the project is, the local development quick start, architecture
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): branches, CI, release preparation
- [Testing](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/testing.md): how make test works and the traps that make it lie
- [API reference](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/api/README.md): every whitelisted endpoint, generated from source (make api-docs)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/developers/index.md): the three apps, the data flow, where extensions, the Data Service and MCP attach
- [Build an extension](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/extensions/README.md): quick start, manifest, lifecycle, hooks, rules, testing and CI, release
- [Extension hooks](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/docs/extensions/hooks.md): the named hooks the core exposes to extensions
- [Makefile](https://github.com/Old-Steel-Arsenal/opengunstore/blob/main/Makefile): every development entry point (make help lists them)
